supplemental_items.interpretation: Both Blue ordinals are integer-converted and looked up independently in the full map; null associations yield null formation pairs, but recorded Blue stop fields are still projected. Only each formation main time is emitted, not its resolved formation event. Reaction ordinal uses inclusive one-based bounds; missing association suppresses exact confirmation but leaves recorded First/Break times. Confirmation uses intrabar-start false. Parent is constant null; currentOrder requires exact A cause with null family and proven stop. Own stop projection is separate.
supplemental_items.conditional_boundary: No empirical runtime or cross-owner acceptance asserted.
